exercises.question: Which sentence evaluates one choice as better? [¿Cuál evalúa una opción como mejor?]
options: Es mejor esperar antes de decidir. [It is better to wait before deciding.]
Esperamos ayer. [We waited yesterday.]
La opción espera. [The option waits.]

exercises.sentence: Es __ elegir una opción más segura. (preferible) [It is preferable to choose a safer option.]

exercises.english: It is advisable that we review the costs.

sentences: Esperar antes de decidir es mejor. [Waiting before deciding is better.]
Tenemos poca información. [We have little information.]
Es mejor esperar antes de decidir porque tenemos poca información. [It is better to wait before deciding because we have little information.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «to be worth it»? [¿Qué expresión significa «merecer la pena»?]
options: merecer la pena [to be worth it]
en cambio [by contrast]
llegar a un acuerdo [to reach an agreement]

exercises.sentence: Creo que __ la pena aceptar el riesgo. (merecer) [I think it is worth accepting the risk.]

exercises.english: It is better to wait before deciding.

exercises.sentence: Es preferible elegir una opción más segura.
options: It is preferable to choose a safer option.
It is preferable to choose the riskier option.
It is impossible to choose an option.

exercises.sentence: Es conveniente que revisemos los costes.
options: It is advisable that we review the costs.
It is necessary that we ignore the costs.
The costs have already been reviewed yesterday.

exercises.sentence: Creo que merece la pena aceptar el riesgo.

options: It is better to wait before deciding.

Waiting is impossible.

template.prompt: Evaluate one option and give a reason.
template.answer: Es preferible elegir una opción más segura porque el riesgo es menor.

template.prompt: Make a recommendation using es conveniente que + subjunctive.
template.answer: Es conveniente que revisemos los costes antes de decidir.
